theorems.statement: ∀ (P m l : ℕ) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid m) (S O : Set (Euclid P)) (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid m) l), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) γ → IsOpen O → IsCompact (S ∩ pL ⁻¹' tsupport γ) → S ∩ pL ⁻¹' tsupport γ ⊆ O → ∃ γ' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) l, tsupport (γ' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) l) ⊆ O ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((γ' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) l) x) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm ((γ (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, (γ' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) l) x = (γ (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL) ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, exteriorDerivative (γ' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) l) x = (exteriorDerivative γ (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL
